messages:
Mei Chen: heads up — lint-bot started failing on a couple of console route authoring PRs when people use path_regex + header overrides. repro attached below.
Mei Chen: minimal example pasted into the editor triggers the 'header-overrides' lint: 
```yaml
route:
  match:
    path_regex: '^/v1/(users|accounts)/.*$'
  override_headers:
    X-Tenant: '{{tenant_id}}'
```
Mei Chen: the rule complains: "override headers not allowed with regex matcher" which feels too strict. we want header overrides for tenant pinning even when path matching is regex.
lint-bot: lint-rule: header-overrides-with-regex (severity: error) triggered by PR #4321 (meichen/console/route-fix).
lint-bot: suggestion: change to warning or add opt-in config: allow_regex_header_overrides = true.
Raj Patel: I ran into this earlier — original intent was to avoid accidental broad header application when regexes are loose. But the current message gives zero guidance.
Raj Patel: we should either tighten the lint to detect 'catch-all' regex like ").*" or provide an escape hatch in the schema/console UI.
Alice Gomez: UX POV: showing a big red error in the editor for a common valid use is a bad developer experience. +1 for an inline toggle: "Allow header overrides with regex" with tooltip and safety explainer.
Carlos M: Agree on toggle. From infra side I'd prefer a schema-first approach: extend the JSON schema to validate regex shape or add metadata so lint can distinguish intentional vs accidental.
Mei Chen: proposal: update the linter to downgrade to warning unless the regex is overly broad (e.g., '^/.*' or '.*' or missing group anchors). For ambiguous cases, console shows a subtle warning and an inline checkbox "I understand the scope — allow header overrides".
Mei Chen: Implementation notes:
- schema change: add optional property `allow_header_overrides_with_regex: boolean` at the route level (default false).
- linter change: only error if allow_header_overrides_with_regex is absent AND the regex pattern is detected as global.
- console change: when warning is present show a small CTA to flip the flag into the YAML or set it via UI.
Raj Patel: Quick checklist for the PR: add unit tests for linter logic, add schema update (oneOf or additionalProperties?), and add a console E2E to verify checkbox toggles the flag into YAML.
Alice Gomez: For rollout: feature flag the UI toggle behind `console:regex-header-guards`. Start as behind flag, enable for beta orgs first. Also need copy for tooltip explaining risks.
Carlos M: Who will own the schema bump? I can take the JSON Schema patch and linter logic if @Mei can add the console bits.
Mei Chen: I'll take console work + E2E. Carlos take schema + linter unit tests. Raj can review linter heuristics.
Alice Gomez: FYI: I'll add a short note to the route authoring docs and update the linting page with the new config and examples.
lint-bot: noted — created issue #INF-901: "Support header overrides with safe regexes" and linked PR #4321.
Mei Chen: moving to a quick triage: Carlos — please push a branch with schema PR draft by EOD Wednesday? Raj — can you draft the regex heuristics rules in a short doc (examples of dangerous patterns) so tests can encode them?
Raj Patel: yup, will draft heuristics doc and include test vectors (safe vs unsafe).
Carlos M: will aim for Wed EOD. tagging @eng-platform for visibility. :wave:
Mei Chen: thanks all. will follow up in the PR thread. :thumbsup:
